characters.name: 钳卫
characters.detail: Character: GATEKEEPER, humanoid data-center maintenance/security worker, inspired by modern Tesla Optimus architecture. Upright biped, compact athletic rather than tall fragile proportions, humanoid black smooth sensor head with a narrow AMBER vertical optical slit, ceramic pearl gray upper torso/thigh shells, desaturated cobalt-blue shoulders and shins, exposed graphite waist and slim precision rotary joints. Clearly asymmetrical: near-side right forearm has a sizeable integrated two-jaw server handling clamp; other arm has a dexterous mechanical hand. Clamp is unmistakable in SIDE view, aimed down-forward beside hip with open space to chest, ends below elbow, not a firearm. Each jaw has dark compliant pads and amber energized grip contacts; clamp has a visible two-stage linear actuator. Battery module integrated flush between shoulder blades. Amber status core on chest and narrow joint indicators; integrated high-end machine-vision optics. Rubber sole feet slightly enlarged for stance readability, narrower waist, strong shoulder to leg silhouette. In ATTACK side view, brace one foot forward, twist shoulder, pull clamp arm back/up before a clear forward sweeping strike; intended attack is slow readable melee. Idle side profile must look game-ready and distinctive, not like a realistic person. Core silhouette taller than wide; relative planned height about 1.2 pelican hero heights.
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone production character design sheet for a horizontal side-scrolling 2.5D action game, Pelican 429. This is a NEW ORIGINAL design adapted from supplied references, not a product advertisement. Reference 1 is the game's real stylized pelican protagonist: match the rounded bevels, appealing dimensional shapes, broad readable forms, refined game-like PBR shading and slightly exaggerated proportions. Reference 2 is the moody ruined mountain data-center environment; use its atmosphere only in a very restrained cool-gray background and a narrow ground line, do not reproduce UI or ruins. Reference 3 is an earlier four-character roster: preserve ONLY this character's distinct functional architecture, greatly improve its tech sophistication and side-view readability.
ABSOLUTELY CRITICAL CAMERA: a true horizontal side-scrolling orthographic camera, eye-level, sees right-facing side profile, nose/face/attack aims to image RIGHT, no overhead view, no perspective foreshortening in the main view. Robots move in the screen plane. Wide landscape sheet, roughly 3:2. Exactly FOUR views of the SAME IDENTICAL design: large RIGHT-FACING ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE idle profile on left half (about 50% page), two smaller aligned FRONT and BACK views in upper right, one smaller RIGHT-FACING SIDE attack windup pose in lower right. Keep the design, proportions, number of parts, colors and equipment consistent in all views. Whole bodies visible with clear spacing, no cropping, no text except small labels SIDE, FRONT, BACK, ATTACK, no dimension labels. Side and action views clearly show feet/ground or flight height. Maintain black/white shape readability when shrunk to 90 pixels. Production-ready reference, not a screenshot.
Visual language: convincingly ADVANCED MODERN ROBOTICS, clean manufactured carbon composite, ceramic shell panels, precision brushless electric joint actuators, purposeful optical/depth sensors, modular batteries, restrained luminous circuitry integrated into joints and service ports, rich but controlled technology details. One distinct light accent color for this character, colored trim follows mechanical function. No generic neon piping all over. Enough high technology to feel one generation ahead of contemporary real machines, still physically believable. Appealing stylized game antagonist, do not make a cute mascot. No medieval armor, no steampunk, no rust, no military logos, no company trademarks, no guns, no big cartoon face, no oversized human head, no ornate robot greebles. White/neutral studio lighting with subtle cool rim, very clean gray background. Show only the requested robot. characters.name: 巡线犬
characters.detail: Character: LINE HOUND, four-legged cable and power inspection robot based on modern Unitree-style quadruped architecture, tailored as a fast ground enemy. Long low aerodynamic petrol-teal rigid back shell, angular graphite nose with a forward-facing layered stereo-camera cluster, not an animal head. FOUR thin but strong electric legs with visible circular hip motors, articulated knees and broad rubber pads. Far-side legs offset modestly so all FOUR legs can be counted from exact side view; do not turn the camera. A flat luminous LIME GREEN dorsal scan strip integrated in a protective rail, a compact rear orange modular battery visibly latched into back, small flush lidar sensor at forehead (no giant tower). Tech identity: network-scanner, recessed green diagnostics on hips, optical ports, compact cable routing covered by manufactured panels. Long low body, clearly separated bent legs, no weapons, no mouth/teeth/tail, no glowing eye face. In ATTACK side view the front end lowers, rear legs coil, back scan strip brightens, one forefoot stretches forward in a clear pounce windup facing RIGHT. Compact athletic, not a heavy tank or adorable dog. Main body top height about half pelican hero height; readable complete clean silhouette.

characters.name: 哨蜂
characters.detail: Character: WATCH WASP, advanced QUADCOPTER data-center surveillance enemy inspired by DJI guarded quadrotor architecture. A narrow front-to-back pearl-gray central fuselage, sloped graphite nose with a high-tech blue glass compound camera/sensor cluster, four separate horizontally oriented motor/propeller discs in black protective rings on short graphite arms with coral-orange end caps. EXACTLY FOUR lift rotors in four corners, propulsion physically believable, all axes vertical. This is a quadcopter, NOT a flying saucer, NOT a two-engine jet, NOT a winged plane, NOT a helicopter. For strict SIDE profile the near and far rotors overlap naturally; do NOT tilt the camera to show all four, use FRONT/BACK panels to explain structure. Neat visible blade thickness and short underbody clearance. A compact gimballed cyan pulse emitter underneath central body, clearly pointing RIGHT in side view and separate from front camera; emitter is sci-fi optical equipment, no firearm. High-tech details: cyan lidar aperture, tiny red/green navigation lights, flush power cells, protective ring geometry with subtle segmentation. Hovering level in SIDE idle, keep body profile thin, visible horizontal rotor guards. ATTACK side pose banks body forward slightly, gimbal points RIGHT, cyan emitter charges into a bright bead, no projectile stream, clear directional silhouette. Propellers support its weight; no blue thruster jets or anti-gravity. Smallest/lightest of four enemies, distinguish from every ground robot.

characters.name: 搬山
characters.detail: Character: LOADMASTER, compact heavy autonomous SERVER-RACK HANDLING robot, architecture inspired by Boston Dynamics Stretch. Broad low squat electric FOUR-WHEEL base, large rubber tires inset into petrol-teal armor, flat deck with visible orange swappable battery at REAR (LEFT in SIDE view). A single thick asymmetrical articulated industrial arm mounted on rear half of base, high shoulder pivot, hinged elbow, ending in a broad two-jaw server clamp reaching FORWARD (RIGHT). Separate slender camera/lidar mast beside arm pivot, does NOT become a humanoid head. Pale warm-yellow arm covers, graphite electric actuators, glossy black sensors, large cyan-lit rotary joint encoders and recessed diagnostics, robust modern injection-molded and cast pieces. More modern than a forklift, sculpted sealed electric drive and high-torque smart joints, advanced precise technology rather than construction machinery. Big clean negative-space opening inside folded arm; arm overhang and jaws readable from exact SIDE view, side shows two near wheels with far wheels naturally overlapping. Clamp jaws chunky but shaped to hold servers, no teeth, no gun. Heavy slow enemy; clear center of gravity over wheeled base. ATTACK pose side view facing RIGHT: mechanical arm raised high with open clamp pointing down-forward in an unmistakable overhead slam windup; front wheels braced, rear battery exposed. Strongly distinct tall-arm low-body silhouette. Main chassis about 1.6 pelican body lengths wide; no anthropomorphic face, no humanoid torso, no tank tracks, no excavator bucket.
